 Julia Pro: a large 3D printer 
 The Julia Pro prints large parts in one pass. It has a heated chamber,
 a hardened steel nozzle and a bed of 400 by 400 millimetres. The machine
 runs for many hours with no operator at its side. 
 Materials 
 The printer reads PLA, PETG, ABS and nylon with carbon fibre. A dry box
 keeps each spool at a low humidity, so the parts stay strong and clean. 

 Bed: 400 x 400 mm 
 Chamber: 70 degrees Celsius 

 Each machine ships with a calibration report and two years of support
 from the engineers who built it.
